title: ENTRIES FROM HERE
hubHint: A faint signal persists inside the structure.
approachHint: The surface is transmitting. Look closer.
fullscreenInstallHint: On iPad, choose Share → Add to Home Screen → Open as Web App.
narration: The house does not remember in rooms. It remembers in interference: a warm window, a broken transmission, dust suspended between one image and the next. Move close enough and the surface stops being a wall. It becomes a record of everyone who paused to listen.
traceTextBody: Every repetition leaves a small difference. The house keeps those differences longer than it keeps names.
traceImageBody: The distance between the furniture and architecture retains traces of what happened here.
traceVideoBody: A moving record loops where the original signal was interrupted.
rotateDevice: Please rotate the device to landscape orientation.
welcomeMessageButton: A message for those who came here
welcomeMessageParagraphs: Hello. Until recently, I lived here. I gathered the records left by the previous residents and the things I observed in this place to create this page. You might call it a small guide to the things that have not yet been noticed.

I do not think I will be able to return here. If you have a detector, please look for the companion entity by the window. If you find it, I would be grateful if you left a note here about how it is doing. If you do not have a detector, I simply hope you find a good feeling there.
